routing_adjudication.why: Methods report clays bought as hardened balls sold for topical sunscreen and cultural use; paper also examines cosmetic ingredient applications. Direct market-material occurrence, not an environmental release or soil-to-crop study.
routing_adjudication.why_unsupported: No food/supplement, infant-specific sunscreen, plant-transfer, industrial apportionment or aluminum concentration was measured.
routing_adjudication.product_fit: Broad leave-on sun/suntan row; source explicitly describes hardened clay balls sold for topical sun protection; not infant/formulated sunscreen. Dry preparation preserved; no row-native as-sold conversion.

can_support: Source-local total-metal occurrence in laboratory-prepared red and white market cosmetic clays.
Per-material variation at named South African provenance.
cannot_support: Representative South African cosmetic concentrations or multi-region distributions.
Concentrations in finished formulations, infant sunscreen, marine fish, foods or clay supplements.
Cr(VI), methylmercury or inorganic arsenic values.
Zero values or numerical upper bounds for absent/not-detected analytes.
Verified legal compliance, dermal dose, clinical harm or sunscreen efficacy.
